name: Aurumvorax — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Aurumvorax from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Aurumvorax", "Aurumvorax (3pp)" but are not part of the Aurumvorax entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Aurumvorax

Variant: Aurumvorax, Adamantine Gorger (CR 9)

[Source]

Powerful muscles ripple beneath the black metallic fur of this small yet fearsome eight-legged beast.

Adamantine gorgers consume raw adamantine ore as part of their dietary needs, though they still need fresh meat as well. Drow truly despise them for this as they go far deeper into the earth than their normal cousins.

DR 10/adamantine; this replaces an aurumvorax’s normal DR and Resist fire 10.

Adamantine Attacks (Ex)

From d20pfsrd.com: Aurumvorax (3pp)

Special Attacks rake (4 claws +18, 1d4+5)

TACTICS

During Combat The aurumvorax attacks by biting a foe and holding on with its powerful jaws. It then rips the foe apart with its claws. An aurumvorax that grabs its prey with its jaws does not release the hold unless broken until either it or its prey is dead.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate plains, hills, or forests
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure standard

The aurumvorax (also called the golden gorger) is an extremely vicious creature, attacking any living prey within its territory (and its territory often extends up to 1 mile in all directions away from its lair). The aurumvorax is 3 feet long and weighs about 200 pounds. The creature’s claws end in razor-sharp, copper colored nails. The aurumvorax’s eyes are silver with gold pupils. Small whiskers and hairs near its face are bronze in color.
